topic: Finding the area of a rectangular patio
core_question: A rectangular patio measures 18 feet by 13 feet. What is its area in square feet?
answer_summary: 234 square feet (18 ft by 13 ft patio)
persona: friendly but persistent; texting quickly with typos here and there
